corrections.text: The headline says the outage "Hit 18 Regions". That figure is The Register's count "at the time of writing" (its article was updated after Microsoft reported mitigation). Microsoft's status history entry 7Q30-010 says only "multiple regions", gives no total, and notes that "Impacted region(s) within a previous communication has been corrected", so the final number of affected regions is not confirmed by Microsoft.
